objective: Promote the smallest safe writable Challenge Contract capability: an explicitly accepted Challenge is created atomically with an exact bounded recovery contract, a missed Challenge expires atomically with creation of that predeclared recovery quest, earned progression is preserved, and Challenge remains an optional Quest modifier rather than a mandatory progression rung.

roles_before.artifact: Quest v2 owns objectives, evidence, lifecycle, deadline and reward semantics.
NONE and HARD_EXTERNAL are writable; RECOMMENDED_WINDOW is planning-only; CHALLENGE is fail-closed.
Multiple OPEN quests may coexist; at most one FOCUSED; creation never steals focus.
Quest difficulty/reward, outcome-key, evidence-followthrough and atomic resolution contracts remain authoritative.
Neon system_events is the sole mutable derived-RPG owner; PWA is projection-only.
Challenge is optional and independent of Boss/Arc/Rank/Unlock semantics.
Exact artificial deadline and exact bounded recovery consequence require user acceptance; engineering may not silently convert an existing quest.
Existing hard external deadline expiry/reminder behavior remains unchanged.
Recommended windows remain informational and non-terminal.
Git history and exact base SHA restore the pre-Challenge writable runtime.

role_dispositions.destination: Challenge composes with normal Quest v2; completion/progress/reward remain normal Quest semantics.
The existing Timing v2 role remains authoritative and gains CHALLENGE only through an atomic compound action with a future artificial deadline and exact recovery contract.
Recovery creation does not steal focus. If the missed Challenge had focus, termination may leave focus empty for normal strategic re-evaluation.
Challenge label never multiplies reward; recovery is unscored by default; no double reward or evidence weakening.
Persist one append-only challenge.declared contract event plus ordinary Quest lifecycle events in system_events; no second store/table owner.
No Boss/Arc/Rank/new-Unlock write behavior is added.
Capability is writable only when the caller supplies the exact accepted Challenge and recovery contract; this slice does not mutate Ron's current quest.
Deadline engine keeps legacy/HARD_EXTERNAL expiry path unchanged.
Base 6515e432cf1cd84f59c8c45594c27ca610a2ee7c plus Git history restore the prior fail-closed Challenge runtime.

capability_probes.assertion: Challenge contract declaration and its Quest creation commit together or not at all in PostgreSQL.
A missed Challenge terminalizes and creates exactly one predeclared RECOVERY quest in one PostgreSQL transaction.
Challenge requires contract_id, future deadline, exact recovery title/objective/target/unit, visible Quest v2 and normalized identifiers.
Repeated create/sweep calls replay without duplicate Challenge declarations, expiry events or recovery quests.
Recovery creation never writes quest.focused or steals unrelated focus.
HARD_EXTERNAL/legacy deadline quests still expire and notify exactly as before without recovery creation.
Challenge activation preserves the existing PWA session, snapshot refresh, notification acknowledgement, installability and push-delivery capabilities outside the new Challenge timing presentation.
Challenge label adds no XP/Coins; recovery is unscored by default and cannot re-award parent progress.
Challenge with missing/unsafe malformed recovery contract fails closed before persistence.
This v1 capability does not silently retrofit an already-created Quest into Challenge mode.
Challenge must be player-visible when accepted; hidden Challenge creation is rejected.
Exact base restores fail-closed Challenge behavior without rewriting historical events.

tests.expected: Normalization, fail-closed invalid contracts, projection and deterministic recovery ids pass.
Challenge miss plans atomic recovery; HARD_EXTERNAL and recommended-window regressions remain green.
PostgreSQL atomic create/recovery, uniqueness, rollback and idempotency pass.
Recovery creation does not alter existing focus semantics.
Architecture manifest and preservation probes pass.
